scene.ko: 물이 새는 커피 메이커를 영수증과 함께 가져가 환불을 고르고, 환불이 언제 들어오는지 묻는다.

lines.en: Hi there. How can I help you today?
Hi. I bought this coffee maker last week, but it leaks every time I use it.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 지난주에 이 커피 메이커를 샀는데, 쓸 때마다 물이 새요.
alt: Hi. I got this coffee maker last week, and it leaks whenever I use it.
Hello. This coffee maker I bought last week keeps leaking.

lines.en: I'm sorry about that. Do you have your receipt?
Yes, here it is. I still have the box, too.
lines.ko: 네, 여기 있어요. 상자도 아직 있어요.
alt: Yes, here you go. I kept the box as well.
Here's the receipt. I have the original box, too.

lines.en: Great. Would you like to exchange it for a new one, or get a refund?
lines.ko: 좋습니다. 새 제품으로 교환하시겠어요, 아니면 환불받으시겠어요?

lines.en: I'd prefer a refund, if that's okay. I think I'll try a different model.
lines.ko: 괜찮으시다면 환불받고 싶어요. 다른 모델을 써 보려고요.
alt: I'd rather get a refund, please. I want to try another model.
A refund would be better, I think. I'll look for a different model.

lines.en: No problem. I'll put it back on the card you used.
Thanks. How long does it take for the refund to go through?
alt: Thank you. When will I get the money back?
Thanks. How long will the refund take?

lines.en: Usually three to five business days. Here's your return receipt.
lines.ko: 보통 영업일로 3~5일 걸려요. 여기 반품 영수증입니다.

expressions.note: exchange A for B = A 를 B 로 바꾸다

expressions.en: How long does it take for ___?
